I'm working through the remaining candidates: "autosomal recessive disease" is a disease class, and "deficiency" is a general term that gets no label. The "PKU" mentions at 300-303 and 906-909 are both specific disease mentions. "Variant forms of the disease" reads as a family of specific diseases, so I'm leaning toward labeling it a disease class.

I'm settling the label for the "PKU" inside "PKU patients," which counts as a modifier of "patients," so it gets the Modifier label rather than SpecificDisease. The other "PKU" mentions, the "Phenylketonuria (PKU)" pair and the one in "typical PKU," are used as the disease name itself and stay SpecificDisease.

I'm wrapping up the labels for the remaining candidates, with "deficiency" left unlabeled as a general term. I'm going with DiseaseClass for "variant forms of the disease," since it reads as a family of specific diseases, and I'm setting the output as a single-line JSON with no markdown.
